scripts.test: pnpm bundle && turbo test --filter=./src... --filter=@alpha-code/vscode-webview... --filter=@alpha-code/vscode-e2e... --log-order grouped --output-logs new-only
scripts.test:core:regressions: pnpm --dir src test --maxWorkers=2 core/tools/__tests__/ToolRepetitionDetector.progress.spec.ts core/task/__tests__/Task.ticket-progress.spec.ts core/task/__tests__/Task.failure-recovery.spec.ts core/task/__tests__/Task.compaction-safety.spec.ts core/auto-approval/__tests__/AutoApprovalHandler.spec.ts core/tools/__tests__/ReadCommandOutputTool.test.ts core/tools/__tests__/readFileTool.spec.ts core/tools/__tests__/accessMcpResourceTool.spec.ts core/tools/__tests__/useMcpToolTool.spec.ts core/tools/__tests__/TicketTools.spec.ts core/tools/__tests__/TicketTools.autoApproval.integration.spec.ts && pnpm --filter @alpha-code/core test src/worktree/__tests__/managed-subagent-worktree.persistence.spec.ts
scripts.clean: turbo clean --log-order grouped --output-logs new-only && rimraf dist out bin .vite-port .turbo
scripts.install:vsix: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm clean && pnpm vsix && node scripts/install-vsix.js
scripts.evals:offline-certify: dotenvx run -f packages/evals/.env.development packages/evals/.env.local -- node scripts/offline-certify.mjs
scripts.evals:offline-certify:full: dotenvx run -f packages/evals/.env.development packages/evals/.env.local -- node scripts/offline-certify.mjs --full
scripts.changeset:version: cp CHANGELOG.md src/CHANGELOG.md && changeset version && cp -vf src/CHANGELOG.md .
scripts.evals: dotenvx run -f packages/evals/.env.development packages/evals/.env.local -- docker compose -f packages/evals/docker-compose.yml --profile server --profile runner up --build --scale runner=0
scripts.test:all: pnpm test && pnpm test:tooling && pnpm --filter @alpha-code/vscode-e2e test:unit && pnpm test:evals
scripts.test:evals:offline: pnpm --filter @alpha-code/evals test:unit && pnpm --filter @alpha-code/evals test:contract && pnpm --filter @alpha-code/evals test:certification
